## What this changes

<!-- In plain words: what a person using the plugin will notice. -->

## Checked

- [ ] `node check.mjs` passes (and `node mutate.mjs` if a rule changed)
- [ ] A test fails without this change and passes with it
- [ ] Nothing new is saved, read or sent anywhere that PRIVACY.md doesn't describe
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## Unreleased`, and the version is untouched
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), under the Developer Certificate of Origin

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/zdraveski/project-memory/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#sending-a-change).
